description: Bitcoin: Fetch multiple series in a single request. Supports filtering by index and date range. Returns an array of SeriesData objects. For a single series, use `get_series` instead.

end.description: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end.

index.description: Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year), block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return; with `end` too, the tighter of the two applies. Omitted, the rest of the range.

series.description:
Comma-separated list of series names

Deserialization permits at most 32 names, each exact, and 2,048 decoded input
string bytes. Array members must all be strings and share the byte budget.

start.description: Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end.

name: get_series_bulk
title: Bulk series data
